dialogue.en: Welcome to Minusburg — the city of Subtraction!
Our Gym Leader, Minessa, is a master of taking things away.
Visit the Pokemon Center if you need to heal up!
In Minusburg, we learn that subtraction isn't about losing.
It's about finding the difference! 10 minus 7 equals 3.
The difference between my Pokemon and yours... let's find out!
Back in my day, we subtracted by hand!
The mountains to the west are full of wild Pokemon. Be careful!
Minessa's Gym is right here! She uses Poison and Dark types.
They'll subtract your HP fast if you're not prepared!
The lake at the south of town is perfect for fishing.
I caught a Magikarp here yesterday... minus the excitement.
I've been studying subtraction all day! Let me test what I learned!
I sell rare items from across Numeria!
The Mart has basic supplies, but come find me for the good stuff.
I'm researching negative numbers and their relationship to Pokemon types.
Did you know? Subtracting a negative is the same as adding! Mind-blowing!
You beat Gym 1 already? Hmph. Do not get used to winning.
dialogue.he: כבר ניצחת את חדר הכושר הראשון? המ. אל תתרגל לנצח.
